I got to the end boss even with the xp bug and killed him, unlocking the achievement for beating the game and the sniper character before being tagged by a stray bullet and dying in front of the teleporter.
100/10 would pillage again

Side-scrolling, non-stop, shoot-em-up action! Bring a few friends and try to survive waves of enemies and bosses. Characters, items and achievements to unlock, try to get to the end! Find the portals quick on the later levels, and pick your items carefully. Level up, rack up some gold, and kill everything in sight! This game is really fun! I got to the end once by myself, not sure how I did it, I guess with some skill and a lot of luck, you can do it. This game can be very challenging. The levels, enemies and items are random everytime you play, which might keep you coming back for more. Like I said, bring some friends, you will probably need the help. Good luck.

Its a hard game to get the hang of initially, but its addicting as hell for a non-stop action arcade sidescroller. Lots of powerups and artifacts that give many interesting boosts and super weapons. Your character can pile on power up after power up and the difficulty is always increasing. Definitely worth getting on sale or regular price.

Its Oct 31 2014 right now, this game is included in the current humble bundle for another 11 days or so. Get 4 copies plus many other great games for less then the cost of this game on steam right now!

awesome game for coop. as of writing this I've only had the game for a week but have spent a good 30+ hours playing both single and multiplayer, which is extremely rare for me nowadays with any game. gameplay is fun and rewarding and can get extremely tense, especially as the timer runs up. I've not tried any online multiplayer but everything has otherwise functionally been smooth sailing for me. currently I use a PS3 controller to play the game on Windows 7, using BetterDS3 to get the game to recognize the controller as an XBox controller.

ps the soundtrack is really fantastic
